questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to cook quick, healthy meals after work
Why so many restaurants in France are closing
How Michelin stars are awarded to restaurants
The career of a successful South African chef
questions.why: They hear from South African chef Chantel Dartnall about how her career developed.

questions.q: How do Neil and Becca feel about cooking?
options: They both hate cooking and usually eat out
Neil finds it relaxing; Becca likes cooking for others
Becca finds it relaxing, but Neil never cooks
They both only cook at weekends for family
questions.why: Neil finds it relaxing; Becca enjoys feeding others but not cooking for herself after work.

questions.q: What does Becca say about working as a top chef?
options: Many chefs work 15 hours a day, six days a week
Most chefs work part time
Kitchens are usually calm places
Chefs are the best-paid restaurant workers
questions.why: She says many chefs work 15 hours a day, six days a week, in stressful kitchens.

questions.q: What did Chantel Dartnall do after she graduated?
options: She opened her own restaurant straight away
She worked in a café in South Africa for years
She sent her CV to all three-star restaurants
She went to study French cooking in Paris
questions.why: She says she sent her CV to all the three-Michelin-star restaurants in the Michelin Guide.

questions.q: Why wasn't Chantel afraid to apply to such famous restaurants?
options: She already knew the chefs from college
She felt she had nothing to lose if they said no
Her college had promised her a job there
She had already won many cooking prizes
questions.why: She says 'The only thing that they could say was no, and what would I lose?'

options: Every single restaurant rejected her application
She had to wait over a year for an answer
She decided to go back to college to study more
Chef Paul Rhodes called and asked when she could start
questions.why: She received a call from chef Paul Rhodes saying 'When can you start?'

questions.q: What made Chantel's restaurant Mosaic different in South Africa?
options: It used edible flowers and herbs, rare there
It served only classic French food and wine
It was the cheapest restaurant in Pretoria
It had no menu, so guests ate what they got
questions.why: She was inspired by botanical cuisine, which was 'very much unknown' in South Africa.

questions.q: What does Neil suggest about Chantel's future?
options: She will probably return to London
She has already won three Michelin stars
She will probably win Michelin stars soon
She plans to stop cooking
questions.why: Neil says she's still waiting, 'but surely it's only a matter of time' before she wins them.
